review_scope: Bounded source/assertion review. Parent findings and gate-results supersede draft/run status. Neither whole-clause nor all-feature certification.

reviewer_record.question: Does the explicit §8.9.5.1 error-on-inconsistent-base-image rule reach a /Decode array whose length is correct but whose element is not numeric?
reviewer_record.primary_evidence: Table 87 types Decode as an array of numbers; its row requires array numeric pairs by color component. §8.9.5.1 requires error when attempting to use inconsistent image dictionary entries.
reviewer_record.current_code: inconsistent_entries() returns no issue for correct array length irrespective of contents; Decode::read filters non-numbers. For [0 1 null 1 0 1], later values shift pairs rather than erroring.
reviewer_record.disposition: Likely test gap/implementation gap; do not conflate this with unsupported reader rejection based solely on a producer constraint. The general image dictionary error sentence is reader-directed. A focused draft is in drafts/decode_non_number.rs.
reviewer_record.confidence: medium-high; parent should run and adjudicate fixture/report behavior

reviewer_record.decision: JPX SMaskInData and conflicting Mask entries
reviewer_record.question: Can we report mandatory wrong rendering where nonzero SMaskInData coexists with /SMask or /Mask?
reviewer_record.primary_evidence: §7.4.9 / Table 87 says nonzero means one opacity channel, SMask shall not be present; §11.6.4.3 describes mask precedence. This is producer-invalid when both are provided, and no direct reader error policy was identified for this conflict.
reviewer_record.disposition: No mandatory reader failure claim. Check recovery behavior only as a documented choice if requested. Valid files with nonzero SMaskInData still need channel-alpha consumer evidence.

reviewer_record.question: Does the Annex-C route and writer special case have independent evidence?
reviewer_record.primary_evidence: PIMA 7667 Annex C, C7/C8+B9 conversion; T.801 M.25 code 18. ADR 2863 constrains re-route.
reviewer_record.disposition: Good evidence: expected color channels hand calculated; 4 in-gamut + 2 out-of-gamut pixels, plus writer value and named-refusal controls. No need to duplicate this test. Remaining edge is channel-depth disagreement path currently intentionally remains codec matrix.
reviewer_record.confidence: high for asserted sample points; not full sYCC domain

reviewer_record.question: Is Table 143 same-grid rule misapplied to masks without Matte?
reviewer_record.primary_evidence: Table 143 says width/height same only if Matte present; otherwise independent; both images map to unit square regardless of sample coincidence.
reviewer_record.disposition: Code/test descriptions show independent soft-mask grids and deferred placement. The base samples are not required to pair by index unless Matte requires same dimensions; unit-square placement is the actual rule. No additional mandatory failure found in the inspected test set.
